name: TRAX
author: Trax
description:
A music player for the PSP. Plays what is already on the card, with no converting and no companion app: MP3, FLAC up to 24-bit/192 kHz, ALAC and AAC in an m4a, WAV, Opus, and ATRAC3 and ATRAC3plus on the PSP's own Media Engine. Cue-sheet albums open like folders. Cover art comes from the folder.

Thirteen visualizations, among them a cassette deck whose reels wind in real time and whose shell is described in JSON, so a tape you actually owned can be rebuilt. Also analogue VU meters, level meters, an orb, a starfield, ribbons, glowing balls, LED bars, spectrum rays, a waveform, a ring, a waterfall, and lyrics from an lrc file beside the track.

A ten-band equalizer, an album gallery, six play modes including a global shuffle that walks the whole card in a couple of seconds, a sleep timer, screen-off while playing, and resume where you left off. The headphone remote works, including with the screen off.

Music goes in PSP/MUSIC on the card, or MUSIC at the root. Can also stream from a Subsonic server such as Navidrome, or from Jellyfin.

There is a native PlayStation Vita build as well, listed separately under Vita.
requirements: Custom firmware. Tested on ARK-4. Music goes in PSP/MUSIC or MUSIC at the root of the card.
